newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Philip Morris raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Philip Morris raised.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers said analyst Diana Temple upgraded Philip Morris Cos Inc to buy from hold.

-- "We now believe that the (tobacco) industry wants to reach an agreement sooner rather than later, at a time when the (price/earnings) multiple disparity between Philip Morris and comparable growth stocks has widened," Temple said in a report. "We view the settlement as removing cataclysmic risk but not all litigation risk."

-- Temple said heard "outline" of possible settlement, mentioning a $12 billion annual payment --- $0.50 per pack -- to the states for smoking related diseases with no punitive damages and no class actions but continuation of individual suits.
-- said Florida flight attendant trial beginning June 2 "looks good for the industry."
-- sees Philip Morris shares in a $40-$50 range in 1997 and $53-$56 in 1998.
